subject.title: [TUI] Scroll-jump / auto-scroll behavior is still disruptive in 2026.3.8

question: Should this TUI tracker be fixed as renderer behavior only, as an explicit TUI auto-follow mode or setting, or as both?
rationale: Source inspection supports a credible TUI renderer path, but choosing default terminal follow behavior and whether to expose a new user-facing mode requires maintainer UX direction before automation should implement it.

options.title: Fix renderer and define TUI anchoring
options.body: Patch or bump the renderer so content-driven redraws do not clear or replay scrollback, then add only the minimal TUI anchoring semantics needed for stable reading.

options.title: Add a TUI auto-follow control
options.body: Expose a TUI near-bottom/off/always-style control similar in spirit to WebChat while preserving terminal-specific renderer safety.

options.title: Wait for the narrow scrollback bug first
options.body: Resolve the narrower renderer scrollback-clearing tracker before deciding whether this broader auto-scroll request still needs a TUI setting.

recommendation.title: Fix renderer and define TUI anchoring
recommendation.body: Patch or bump the renderer so content-driven redraws do not clear or replay scrollback, then add only the minimal TUI anchoring semantics needed for stable reading.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent TUI docs/integration history and product-shape context make steipete the best available owner for the renderer-vs-setting decision.
